environment.build_host: macdaddy (builds only, no timing; fresh git worktrees bootstrapped with scripts/worktree-bootstrap.sh --web)
environment.recipe: docs/perf/close-camera-draws/README.md (fee30bd): e2e/perf-close-camera.mjs and e2e/perf-close-camera-native.mjs from the after arm, ROUNDS=4, arms alternate order each round, every run inside e2e/perf-load.mjs's guard (1-minute load <= 15 before and after)

web.browser: Playwright 1.63.0 Chromium, HeadlessChrome/153.0.0.0, new headless, channel chromium, uncapped (--disable-gpu-vsync --disable-frame-rate-limit), --use-angle=metal --enable-gpu --ignore-gpu-blocklist --enable-unsafe-webgpu

native.args: --present immediate --size 2560x1440 (scale factor override 1.0) --diag, each binary run from its own checkout-shaped directory (assets/ beside target/release/)
native.surface_check: probe screenshot from the after binary measured 2560x1440 px
native.pacing: native play pins to 60 Hz (docs/agent-operability.md perf-water-world): a probe of one tile read p50 16.68, mean 16.67 ms, so native frame times at or near 16.67 ms are pacing, not render cost
native.adapter_from_probe: Apple M4 | Metal | IntegratedGpu (diag.adapter of the after binary's probe run on MiniMac; the harness does not record it per sample)
